description: This file contains unit tests for the TenantObject class, verifying serialization/deserialization, trust anchor handling, adapter configuration, resource limits, and other tenant-related functionalities within the Eclipse Hono project.

classes.name: TenantObjectTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing TenantObject behaviors such as deserialization, trust anchors, adapter enablement, resource limits, and other tenant configuration aspects.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Sets up static trust store fixture before tests run.

methods.name: getCaCertificate
methods.description: Loads and returns a CA certificate from a trust store.

methods.name: testDeserializationOfCustomAdapterConfigProperties
methods.description: Tests deserialization of tenant JSON config with custom adapter properties.

methods.name: testDeserializationOfEmptyTrustedAuthoritiesArray
methods.description: Checks that deserializing tenant with empty trusted-ca array produces empty trust anchors.

methods.name: testDeserializationOfPublicKeyTrustAnchors
methods.description: Verifies deserialization of trust anchors from Base64-encoded public key data.

methods.name: testIsAdapterEnabledForEmptyConfiguration
methods.description: Ensures that all adapters are enabled by default if no configuration is set.

methods.name: testIsAdapterEnabledForDisabledTenant
methods.description: Checks that all adapters are disabled when tenant is marked disabled.

methods.name: testIsAdapterEnabledForNonEmptyConfiguration
methods.description: Ensures only explicitly enabled adapters are active.

methods.name: testGetTrustAnchorsUsesPublicKey
methods.description: Validates trust anchor uses configured public key and subject DN.

methods.name: testGetTrustAnchorFailsForInvalidBase64EncodingOfPublicKey
methods.description: Verifies behavior when trust anchor public key decoding fails.

methods.name: testGetMaxTTDFromAdapterConfiguration
methods.description: Checks maximum time till disconnect (TTD) value from adapter extensions.

methods.name: testGetMaxTTDReturnsDefaultValue
methods.description: Confirms default TTD value when not specified.

methods.name: testGetMaxTTDReturnsDefaultValueInsteadOfIllegalValue
methods.description: Ensures TTD defaults to constant when set to negative value.

methods.name: testGetResourceLimits
methods.description: Verifies resource limits are correctly parsed from config.

methods.name: testGetResourceLimitsWhenNotSet
methods.description: Checks that null is returned when resource limits are absent.

methods.name: testGetMinimumMessageSize
methods.description: Checks retrieval of configured minimum message size.

methods.name: testGetMinimumMessageSizeNotSet
methods.description: Verifies default minimum message size when none is configured.
